name: DotField-TS-TW
title: Dot Field
description: A near-black background covered in a fine grid of small violet dots. A soft purple glow follows the pointer and pushes the nearby dots outward, then they settle back.
use: You want a technical, understated background that reacts to the pointer behind a dark hero or product page.
avoid: It only reacts to a mouse, so touch users see a static dot grid, and the effect never fully settles.
a11y: The dot grid animates continuously and reacts only to a mouse; it ignores reduced-motion and has no label. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark field of evenly spaced tiny violet dots on near-black, brighter toward the top and fading at the edges. At rest it reads as a fine grid; where the pointer sits, a soft purple halo blooms and the dots around it swell apart.
behaves: Moving the cursor drags a purple glow and a bulge through the grid, pushing nearby dots outward while distant ones spring back; when the pointer stops, the glow fades. A gentle wave can also ripple the rows.
customise: Props set dot radius and spacing, cursor radius and force, bulge-only mode and strength, glow radius and colour, sparkle, wave amplitude and the two gradient colours.
weight: moderate: A 2D canvas redraws a grid of roughly two thousand dots every frame.
demo: A heading 'Dot Field' with the line 'Move your cursor to bend the grid.'
issues: It only reacts to a mouse; touch and keyboard users just see a static grid.
The animation loop runs forever, even when nothing is moving.
polishWhy: Crisp dot grid and a smooth purple glow, but it is a familiar effect and pointer-only.
